attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Pharmacy Examining Board (Department of Safety and Professional Services)

rules.alternatives: Technicians who administer vaccines need a one-time 2-hour ACPE- or Board-approved injection-technique course, current BLS/CPR and PTCB or NHA certification (Wis. Stat. § 450.035(2h)).
rules.notes: Registration renews without a CE requirement (DSPS: «There is no continuing education requirement for this credential»). Pharmacy technicians have been registered by the Pharmacy Examining Board under Wis. Admin. Code ch. Phar 19 since 2021 Wisconsin Act 100.
rules.legal_basis: Wis. Stat. ch. 450; Wis. Admin. Code ch. Phar 19
rules.rule_quote: There is no continuing education requirement for this credential.
